shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak realm keys using Keycloak API

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect I(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with I(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: config
options.description: Dict specifying the key and its properties.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: force
options.description: Enforce the state of the private key and certificate. This is not automatically the case as this module is unable to determine the current state of the private key and thus cannot trigger an update based on an actual divergence. That said, a private key update may happen even if force is false as a side-effect of other changes.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the realm key to create.

options.name: parent_id
options.description: The parent_id of the realm key. In practice the name of the realm.

options.name: provider_id
options.description: The name of the "provider ID" for the key. The value V(rsa-enc) has been added in middleware_automation.keycloak 8.2.0. The value V(java-keystore) has been added in middleware_automation.keycloak 12.4.0. This provider imports keys from a Java Keystore (JKS or PKCS12) file located on the Keycloak server filesystem. The values V(rsa-generated), V(hmac-generated), V(aes-generated), and V(ecdsa-generated) have been added in middleware_automation.keycloak 3.0.0. These are auto-generated key providers

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the keycloak realm key. On V(present), the realm key is created (or updated if it exists already). On V(absent), the realm key is removed if it exists.

options.name: update_password
options.description: Controls when passwords are sent to Keycloak for V(java-keystore) provider. V(always) - Always send passwords. Keycloak will update the component even if passwords have not changed. Use when you need to ensure passwords are updated. V(on_create) - Only send passwords when creating a new component. When updating an existing component, send the masked value to preserve existing passwords. This makes the module idempotent for password fields. This is necessary because Keycloak masks passwords in AP

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
